context: A uni student interviews a retired farmer at home
purpose: Teach: 自力/自我/様相/取り巻く/牧場/農場/方位/論者

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 今日はお時間ありがとうございます。長年、牧場を経営されていたんですよね？
lines.en: Thank you for your time today. You ran a cattle ranch for many years, didn't you?
lines.style: Polite university student tone, slightly nervous but earnest interviewer voice

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ああ、若い頃は乳牛の牧場をやっとった。今は息子に譲って、小さな農場で野菜を作っとるよ。
lines.en: Yeah, when I was young I ran a dairy ranch. Now I've handed it to my son and grow vegetables on a small farm.
lines.style: Warm elderly male voice, slow-paced reminiscing with gentle rural cadence

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 戦後すぐの頃は、農業を取り巻く環境も今とはずいぶん違う様相だったと聞きました。
lines.en: I've heard the environment surrounding agriculture right after the war had quite a different look from today.
lines.style: Academic curiosity, leaning forward respectfully while taking notes

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: そりゃもう全然違うわ。機械もないし、地図も粗くてな、方位磁針片手に道なき道を歩いたもんだ。
lines.en: Oh, completely different. There were no machines, the maps were rough too, so we walked trackless paths with a compass in hand.
lines.style: Lively older man recalling hardship with quiet pride, gravelly voice

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 開墾も全部自力でやった。手も足もくたくたになるまで、毎日土と格闘しとったよ。
lines.en: We cleared the land all by our own strength. Hands and feet exhausted, we wrestled with the soil every single day.
lines.style: Continues nostalgically, voice softening with weight of memory

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 自力で、ですか…。便利な時代に育った私たちは、自我がぼんやりしている気がします。
lines.en: By your own strength, huh... Those of us raised in a convenient era, our sense of self feels kind of blurry.
lines.style: Thoughtful uni student, reflective tone with hint of self-criticism

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 難しいことは分からんが、土に触れろと言う論者もおるらしいな。わしもそれは賛成だ。
lines.en: I don't know the difficult stuff, but I hear there are theorists who say to touch the soil. I agree with that much.
lines.style: Folksy wisdom, chuckling softly, conceding the point with humility

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: なるほど…。最後に、これから就農を考える学生に一言いただけますか？
lines.en: I see... Lastly, could you give a word of advice to students considering going into farming?
lines.style: Wrapping up respectfully, hopeful closing question

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 焦るな、ということだな。土は嘘をつかんから、ゆっくり付き合えばええ。
lines.en: Don't be impatient, that's what I'd say. The soil doesn't lie, so just take your time with it.
lines.style: Gentle parting advice, sincere and grandfatherly closing line
